findings.message: rubbings-theft acceptance 3 requires the per-tick invariant ('no ship removed while its player is in the ledger') to hold in every integration test. tests/integration/seaDuelHarness.test.ts 'keeps both fighters on the server's state with 80 ms round trip, 20 ms jitter, 1% loss' runs a full grapple and duel through a real MatchRoom, but runScenario collects its clients with a plain push callback, not tracker()/expectRoomChecks. So room.invariantViolations and room.ledgerRefusals are never asserted for that match. The server keeps checkInvariants on, so a violation would only reach console.error and the test would still pass. Every other MatchRoom test (rubbings*, seaDuel, ledgerSeed, the harness draw, and match/visibility/admission via afterEach) does assert them.
findings.requirement: The restored `rubbings-theft` feature meets all of `features/rubbings-theft/game-task.md`'s acceptance.

findings.message: rubbings-theft's settled design puts sourcesPerIsland sites at each island's docks, 'reusing a dock if the island has fewer' (apps/server/src/objectives.ts sourceSites, docks[slot % docks.length]). The only test, apps/server/src/objectives.test.ts 'puts each island's two sources at its docks in id order', uses seaMap, where every island has at least two docks, so the reuse branch never runs. No test builds a map with a one-dock island to check that the dock is reused.
findings.requirement: The restored `rubbings-theft` feature meets all of `features/rubbings-theft/game-task.md`'s acceptance.
